sourceDifference.summary: Real source change, not a version-number republish. The official Workspace Client grows 232824 -> 284999 bytes with a new SHA-256. Three upstream contract changes matter: built-in Session actions moved from the sidebar.workspaces.session.menu.item slot entries onto ctx.contextMenus.register (the literal 'session-id' is gone, replaced by 'session.<id>'); row components gained useContextMenu/useContextMenuTarget/useSessionAccess/openSessionMenu/home and the official inject list gained contextMenus; and apply reads ctx.remoteAccess as a property instead of through ctx.get. Two of the 38 decoration seams broke because rc.1 inserted a cwd field into the Session node metadata and the hover card; both were narrowed to the rc.5/rc.1 common prefix. Cordis 4.1.0 makes ctx.plugin() return Object.create(fiber) which Loader stores on entry.fiber, breaking identity comparison with ctx.fiber; Loader 1.1.0 replaced the EntryTree.write() persistence hook with commit(change).

peerRange.why: Harness resolves compatibility with semver.satisfies(runtimeVersion, range, { includePrerelease: true }). Under that semantic the open range admits 0.2.1-rc.5, 0.2.2-alpha.3 and 0.2.2-rc.1 while rejecting 0.3.0-alpha.1. The exact locale enumeration was the only peer that failed against 0.2.2-rc.1 and required a manual edit on every Host RC.
